snippet.title: Season 9 Battle Pass: The Faith-Harvesting Engine | Official Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
Unlock the mysteries behind The Faith-Harvesting Engine in Season 9 of Marvel Rivals! 💀

As Apocalypse fell, inexplicable deaths emerged with no culprit found. Use the Faith Harvesting Engine to unlock 10 new costumes with the Deaths on the Nile Season 9 Battle Pass and unveil the truth one step at a time. 

Upgrade to the premium Battle Pass to permanently unlock and reveal new enigmas with the release of Season 9 of Marvel Rivals on July 10th UTC! 

Play free now on:
🔹 Steam: https://t.co/IPhy0Of1cG
🔹 PlayStation: https://t.co/FR0aVfTmcn
🔹 Xbox: https://t.co/GaAYz7Nku6
